body: To the editor: I have lived on Ridge Avenue for 17 years, and I want to say what a difference the Eastgate Senior Lunch Program has made.
Please keep the playground upgrade in the budget. Many of us on Ridge Avenue use it every week.
Thank you for printing this letter, and for all the work the paper does to keep us informed.

articles.title: Brian Schaefer, 63, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Brian Schaefer for the many years of service to Marsh Landing.
body: Born in Marsh Landing in the years after the war, Brian Schaefer spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Millrace Youth Center in his or her name. Brian Schaefer died in May at home on Meadow Court, at the age of 63.
